scope: Verified exact portfolio deadlines; date-only and unannounced calls are excluded from timers and ICS.

deadlines.title: Knight-Hennessy Scholars application deadline
deadlines.notes: The Stanford graduate-program application is separate and may have its own deadline.

deadlines.title: Commonwealth Master's CSC application deadline
deadlines.notes: Bangladesh's nominating agency can set a separate earlier deadline; its date has not been verified. This event covers only the CSC deadline.

deadlines.title: ETH Zurich international Master's / ESOP application deadline
deadlines.notes: Mandatory November window for applicants with an international Bachelor's degree and ESOP applicants; ETH states 30 November 2026 at 11:59 CET.

deadlines.title: DAAD all-disciplines Master's application deadline — Bangladesh
deadlines.notes: Bangladesh-specific deadline is 1 December 2026. DAAD states the portal closes at 24:00 CET/CEST on the final application day, represented here as 00:00 CET on 2 December.

deadlines.title: Cambridge Advanced CS funding application deadline
deadlines.notes: International funding round. Course date plus the university 23:59 UK rule at https://www.postgraduate.study.cam.ac.uk/apply/application-deadlines. References must also arrive in time. The US Gates round is separate.

deadlines.title: MBZUAI MSc Computer Science application deadline
deadlines.notes: Deadline for the MSc Computer Science route; other programmes may differ. Admission and scholarship decisions are separate.

deadlines.title: Oxford Advanced CS deadline — Weidenfeld route
deadlines.notes: Course deadline. Complete the additional Weidenfeld scholarship requirements; this event does not establish funding eligibility.

deadlines.title: Oxford Advanced CS deadline — Clarendon route
deadlines.notes: Same Advanced Computer Science course deadline as the Weidenfeld route. Funding consideration is not a funding guarantee.

deadlines.title: EDISS Erasmus Mundus scholarship application deadline
deadlines.notes: Intake 7 scholarship round opens 16 November 2026. Later tuition-waiver and self-funded rounds are separate.

date_only.notes: Fall 2027 Round 2. Provider labels dates tentative and does not state a closing time. Confirm in the application portal.
